input.question: Where is The Daily Citizen published?

documents.text: Cushing Citizen The Cushing Citizen is a newspaper founded in 1895 as the community newspaper of local town Cushing, Oklahoma. Through the years the newspaper has had numerous owners including O.H. and Hattie Mae Lauchenmeyer. In the past the paper has been issued weekly and then daily. It is currently published twice weekly by David and Myra Reid, who moved to New York City in 1992 when they purchased the "Cushing Daily Citizen" from Francis Stipe.
